P1.full_prompt_utf8: The man with dyed-blond hair lies in bed at night while scrolling on his smartphone. In this continuous shot, The man in bed puts his smartphone on the nightstand and turns over to go to sleep. Follow this event order: The man first stops scrolling while continuing to hold the same smartphone. He then moves the held phone toward the nightstand. The phone reaches and is supported by the nightstand before he releases it. After release, the phone remains on the nightstand while his hand withdraws. Only then does he turn his torso over into a sleeping orientation. The same man, bed, nightstand, scene, lighting, framing, and camera remain stable.
